baseline.kind: canonical scalar APIs from the same installed candidate wheel

configuration.excluded: price normalization, model construction, consumer engine, network access
configuration.input_generator: ordered normalized coordinates extracted from pinned public positive-test cases
configuration.numpy_input: prepared ndarray or Python list, as named
configuration.scalar_input: flat Python list in both modes
configuration.unit: nanoseconds per replay group, result allocation included

dependency_evidence.scope: Same installed candidate and environment; dependency costs measured once in the accompanying synthetic run.

fixture_scope: Public positive-test replay groups, not observed production batches. Each original consumer invocation classifies one coordinate. Price normalization is performed before the timed fuzzy operation.
limitations: installed CI candidate on a shared host, not a published PyPI release
test replay groups, not measured production distributions
memory observations are single samples, RSS is whole-process high water
no private FMA/robot integration or throughput claim
fresh-process imports; verification reads package bytes before timing; filesystem caches are not flushed

provenance.git_field_meaning: package source identity proven against wheel bytes; installed wheels have no Git dirty state
provenance.source_report_adaptation: unchanged public builders/parity/paired timers; isolated installed memory/import dispatch and corrected provenance
